bio: Enjoy a delicious Afternoon Tea experience at Woolley Grange, a unique Wiltshire Hotel.  Woolley Grange honour the tradition of Afternoon Tea with freshly made sandwiches, homemade scones with jam and cream, and some rather fancy cakes and patisserie!  Woolley Grange is a picturesque luxury hotel nestled on the edge of the Cotswolds. Within its stone garden wall lie 14 acres of beautiful grounds, with a walled kitchen garden, numerous areas for children to play and peaceful paths for adults to stroll and enjoy the far reaching views.
